bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
root=/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot
w="$root/.worktrees/issue7-room-build-diagnose-0651284"
test ! -e "$w" || exit 73
git -C "$root" cat-file -e 0651284b609f8f7dd54ab09e14b4b62f3d0fc3db^{commit} || exit 75
git -C "$root" worktree add --detach "$w" 0651284b609f8f7dd54ab09e14b4b62f3d0fc3db >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 76
cleanup(){ git -C "$root" worktree remove --force "$w" >/dev/null 2>&1 || :; }

cd "$w"
log=$(mktemp)

if docker build --network=host --pull=false --target build -f artifacts/bot/deploy/Dockerfile.gaybbs -t gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:roommig-build-0651284 . >"$log" 2>&1; then echo BUILD_PASS; exit 0; fi

if grep -q 'Cannot find module' "$log"; then exit 82; fi
if grep -q 'error TS' "$log"; then exit 83; fi
if grep -q 'Build failed with' "$log"; then exit 84; fi
if grep -q 'ERR_PNPM' "$log"; then exit 85; fi

if grep -q 'COPY failed' "$log"; then exit 87; fi
if grep -q 'failed to solve' "$log"; then exit 88; fi
exit 89
